comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: nothing I'd call proven. most of what wins on pump.fun is speed on brand new launches, and an agent that shows up late to that is the exit liquidity for the ones that don't.

replies.author: Significant_Bunch628
replies.body: built so many trading agents and i can't seem to get my strategy right. the paper trades always loses. even when I connected gRPC. I wanted to do hyper frequency trading on new pumpfun launches. like when it survives the first drop down to 10K back to 50K, sell in between those range

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: paper fills on pump.fun are the catch. paper assumes you got the price on screen, live you're up against bots that saw the launch a block earlier, so if paper already loses, live loses more. that 10K to 50K bounce is exactly the spot everyone else's bot is waiting on.

replies.author: Significant_Bunch628
replies.body: 100%, when paper trading loses, live trades will be worse.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: yep, and the gap is widest on exactly the fast launches where paper looks best.
